# Phase 3 builder brief (shared by every staff-screen builder)

Project: the project root. Read first: `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/agents/screen-builder.md`, `docs/design-system.md` (Motion section especially: staff screens animate only state changes), the Staff section of `docs/plan.md`, and in `docs/brief.md` the "Staff side", "Roles" and the staff lines of "Layout per device" and "Motion hierarchy". Also skim `.claude/briefs/customer-screens.md` for the shared conventions (translations, money, components, states, checks) — they all still apply.

## Staff foundations (use, do not edit)
- Layout: pages named `staff/*` get `resources/js/layouts/staff-layout.tsx` (collapsible sidebar on tablet/desktop, sheet on phones, offline banner); pages named `staff/kitchen*` get `kitchen-layout.tsx` (full screen, dark by default; `setKitchenTheme('light'|'dark')` exported there).
- Access: `App\Enums\StaffArea` maps sections to roles; routes in `routes/staff/<area>.php` are already wrapped in `auth`, `verified`, `staff` middleware, prefix `/staff`, name prefix `staff.`, and `can:staff.<area>`. YOU OWN your area's routes file — add your routes there (names like `staff.orders.index`). For per-record or per-action rules beyond the section (e.g. only managers refund over £50, riders only their own deliveries, only owners change VAT), write a Policy or explicit `Gate::authorize` checks, and test each role.
- Shared props: `staffAreas` (allowed areas for the user), `auth.user` (with `role`), plus the Phase 2 ones.
- Staff components (`resources/js/components/staff/`): `StaffPageHeader` (title, description, actions, children slot for filters/tabs), `OrderStatusBadge`, `ChannelBadge`, `StatTile`, `Elapsed` / `useElapsedMinutes` / `waitTone` (live minutes with fresh/waiting/late colours). Brand and UI components from Phase 2 are all available. Types: `OrderStatus`, `OrderChannel`, `StaffArea` in `@/types`.
- Domain: `App\Services\OrderStateMachine` — `nextFor($order)`, `can()`, `transition($order, OrderStatus, $user, $reason)`, `bump($line, $user)`, `recall($line, $user)`. ALL order/line status changes go through it (never set status directly). Translations for statuses/channels: `staff.status.*`, `staff.channel.*`.
- Models for everything in `app/Models` (Order, OrderLine, OrderStatusEvent, Payment, DiningTable, TableRequest, Reservation, Review, MenuItem, Category, ItemVariant, ModifierGroup, Modifier, PriceChange, Ingredient, RecipeLine, StockMovement, Supplier, PurchaseOrder(+Line), Shift, Attendance, ActivityLog, Setting, DeliveryZone, User with role). Enums in `app/Enums`. `App\Support\Settings` for settings, `App\Support\Money` for £ formatting in PHP, `App\Support\CodeGenerator` for references. dompdf is installed (`Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf`) for PDFs.
- Activity log: when a staff action matters (accept/reject/refund/price change/stock adjustment/settings change/no-show), write an `ActivityLog` row (event, subject, user_id, description in plain English, properties). A tiny helper is fine inside your own files; Phase 4 may centralise it.
- Live data: Reverb arrives in Phase 4. For now use Inertia `usePoll` (5–15 s depending on screen; only while the tab is visible) with partial reloads (`only: [...]`). Structure props so Phase 4 can swap polling for broadcast events without a rewrite.
- Demo logins (password `password`): owner@, manager@, cashier@, waiter@, kitchen@, rider@ and customer@tandoorhouse.test. Seeded data has a live service right now (orders in every active status, table requests, tonight's bookings, low stock).

## Staff UX rules
- Built for speed under pressure: big targets (≥44px, primary actions ≥48px), high contrast, no decorative motion — motion only signals state (a new order highlights once; a ticket shifts colour as it waits). Keyboard shortcuts where natural (document them on screen).
- Tablet first for the floor and kitchen (768–1180 landscape), desktop for back office, but every screen must work at 375 (riders and waiters use phones).
- Dense but legible tables on desktop that turn into stacked cards on phones. Sticky headers for long lists. Search/filter in the URL query string.
- Every state: loading skeletons, empty (calm, specific copy), error, offline (actions disabled with a reason), success toasts, disabled states with reasons.
- Destructive or money actions (reject, refund, delete, no-show) confirm in a dialog and need a reason where it matters.
- All strings in your own `lang/en_GB/staff_<area>.php` file (British English, plain, no jargon). Tokens only.

## Checks before you finish
`npm run types:check`, `npx vp fmt <your paths>` then `npx vp check`, `vendor/bin/pint <your paths>`, `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G`, `php artisan test --compact` (whole suite must stay green), `npm run build`, then screenshots: `node scripts/screenshots.mjs 3 <name>=/staff/...@manager@tandoorhouse.test` (append `@<email>` to sign in; use the role that would really use the screen) and view the 375-light and one 1280 contact sheet (`node scripts/contact-sheet.mjs <in.jpg> storage/app/review/<name>.jpg 2400`). Server: http://127.0.0.1:8010 (`php artisan serve --port=8010`; Herd's PHP-FPM is down on this Mac). Do not run `migrate:fresh` (shared DB) unless the task says so. Do not commit. Touch only your files. Return a summary under 150 words.
